#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/toolchain.h>
#include <zephyr/linker/sections.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/util.h>
#include <stdbool.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Test node structure.
 *
 * This structure defines a single test case within a test suite.
 */
struct ztest_test_node {
	const char *name;
	void (*fn)(void);
	bool is_fast;
};

/**
 * @brief Test suite node structure.
 *
 * This structure defines a test suite, including its name, an array of test
 * cases, and setup/teardown functions.
 */
struct ztest_test_suite_node {
	const char *name;
	const struct ztest_test_node *tests;
	size_t test_count;
	void (*suite_setup)(void);
	void (*suite_teardown)(void);
	void (*test_setup)(void);
	void (*test_teardown)(void);
};

/**
 * @brief Macro to place data in DRAM.
 *
 * This macro is used to place test-related data in the DRAM section.
 */
#define ZTEST_DMEM __attribute__((section(".dram_data")))

/**
 * @brief Macro to place data in noinit section.
 *
 * This macro is used to place test-related data in the noinit section.
 */
#define ZTEST_BMEM __attribute__((section(".noinit")))

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * This macro defines a test case function and registers it within its
 * respective test suite section.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 * @param is_fast_val Boolean indicating if the test is a fast test.
 */
#define ZTEST_TEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, is_fast_val) \
	static void ztest_##suite##_##name(void); \
	ZTEST_DMEM static const struct ztest_test_node __used \
	__attribute__((section("." STRINGIFY(suite) "_test_section"))) \
	_CONCAT(ztest_test_node_, suite, name) = { \
		.name = #name, \
		.fn = ztest_##suite##_##name, \
		.is_fast = is_fast_val \
	}; \
	static void ztest_##suite##_##name(void)

/**
 * @brief Define a standard test case.
 *
 * This macro defines a standard (non-fast) test case.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_TEST_CASE(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_TEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, false)

/**
 * @brief Define a fast test case.
 *
 * This macro defines a fast test case, which might be run more frequently
 * or with specific optimizations.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_TEST_CASE_FAST(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_TEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, true)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * This macro defines a test suite and registers it in the global list of
 * test suites. It also declares the start and stop symbols for the test
 * cases within this suite, which are used by the linker.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup_fn Function to run once before all tests in the suite.
 * @param teardown_fn Function to run once after all tests in the suite.
 * @param test_setup_fn Function to run before each test case.
 * @param test_teardown_fn Function to run after each test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, setup_fn, teardown_fn, test_setup_fn, test_teardown_fn) \
	extern const struct ztest_test_node __start_##suite_name##_test_section[]; \
	extern const struct ztest_test_node __stop_##suite_name##_test_section[]; \
	ZTEST_DMEM static const struct ztest_test_suite_node __used \
	__attribute__((section(".ztest_suites"))) \
	_CONCAT(ztest_suite_node_, suite_name) = { \
		.name = #suite_name, \
		.tests = __start_##suite_name##_test_section, \
		.test_count = (size_t)(__stop_##suite_name##_test_section - \
				       __start_##suite_name##_test_section), \
		.suite_setup = setup_fn, \
		.suite_teardown = teardown_fn, \
		.test_setup = test_setup_fn, \
		.test_teardown = test_teardown_fn, \
	};

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with all setup/teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup_fn Function to run once before all tests in the suite.
 * @param teardown_fn Function to run once after all tests in the suite.
 * @param test_setup_fn Function to run before each test case.
 * @param test_teardown_fn Function to run after each test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE(suite_name, setup_fn, teardown_fn, test_setup_fn, test_teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, setup_fn, teardown_fn, test_setup_fn, test_teardown_fn)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with only a suite setup function.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup_fn Function to run once before all tests in the suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_SINGLE_SETUP(suite_name, setup_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, setup_fn, NULL, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with only a suite teardown function.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param teardown_fn Function to run once after all tests in the suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_SINGLE_TEARDOWN(suite_name, teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, NULL, teardown_fn, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with only a test setup function.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param test_setup_fn Function to run before each test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_TEST_SETUP(suite_name, test_setup_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, NULL, NULL, test_setup_fn, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with only a test teardown function.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 * @param test_teardown_fn Function to run after each test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_TEST_TEARDOWN(suite_name, test_teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, test_teardown_fn)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with no setup or teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite_name The name of the test suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_NO_SETUP(suite_name) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite_name, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
